news.detail: Boerkircher was held out of Thursday's practice due to an illness, but he's past his ailment and will be available to play Sunday. The rookie second-rounder has one catch (on two targets) for nine yards through three regular-season games while serving as the Jaguars' TE2 behind Brenton Strange.

profile: role: TE2 rotational — 4% of targets, 67% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
